method: For each workload, odd rounds run base then worklist; even rounds run worklist then base. Every process performs its own untimed warmup. Only public verification calls are timed. Module cloning, wire and complete certificate validation, and destruction are outside the timed regions. Both variants perform the same number of iterations. All samples must succeed with zero failures, empty stderr, and matching wire and full-certificate digests.
